question:
Find out which animation studio has used a title sequence from a 1928 cartoon short that was the first to achieve synchronized sound since 2007, whose headquarters is informally known to employees as the "Hat Building" because of the giant wizard's hat adorning its top, whose first full-length animated film entered the public domain in 2024 after 95 years of copyright protection, and whose film was released in regular US theaters between January 1, 2000, and December 31, 2024, inclusive. For each film, list its official US theatrical release date (not its premiere date) in "month-day-year" format (e.g., May 19, 2000), as well as any awards and nominations received by the film itself. Do not list individual awards or nominations received by the studio, producers, directors, musicians, or editors.

Display the data in a Markdown table with the columns: Film Name, Release Date, Nominations, Awards.

Note: If no award information is found, indicate "NA."

Don't ask me any questions; just output the results in columns; don't omit cells. The output format is ```markdown
{data_content}
```.
